findings.body: The state/reason filters exclude unconsumed messages whose quiet window ended while they waited for execution capacity. GroupQueue accepts such waiting work (apps/core/src/runtime/group-queue.ts:245–251), and the admission loop settles its items as completed without consuming them (apps/core/src/runtime/live-admission-work-loop.ts:276–282). If ten messages are waiting behind another conversation, /stop cancels none of them. The active-command handler refuses the idle conversation (apps/core/src/app/bootstrap/runtime-services.ts:656–668), and the eventual turn-start take reaches its ten-message limit before reaching /stop, so the cancelled request runs. Preserve the receive-order boundary, but include earlier unconsumed input regardless of its admission scheduling state.
findings.title: Not done: /stop cancels a batch that hasn't started

findings.body: External ingress targets an existing conversation route, but isSessionCommandText parses with an empty trigger (apps/core/src/application/sessions/session-command-parse.ts:278). For a route with trigger Andy, an allowlisted sender's `Andy /stop` or `Andy ! stop` is therefore saved with a quiet window, although turn-start parsing accepts it using the route trigger (apps/core/src/runtime/group-processing.ts:124). The channel-handler fix does not cover this ingress path. Carry the resolved route trigger into command classification so these accepted commands bypass the window too.
findings.title: Not done: session commands never wait

findings.body: The take reads receive order, but presentation sorts by provider timestamp first. A message received second with an older provider timestamp is moved ahead of the first message in the agent prompt, violating the promised received-order batch. The existing test explicitly demonstrates this reversal (apps/core/test/unit/runtime/group-processing-flow.test.ts:8–77), while the new integration test supplies monotonically increasing timestamps and cannot expose it. Preserve receiveOrder when presenting the batch.
findings.title: Not done: messages reach the turn in received order
